description: The hidden window that copies Hachidori's storage from its scheme origin to its loopback origin once (loopback.rs, docs/HACHIDORI_IMPORT_THREADS.md). On the scheme page it may call only the copy's kimochi-ext commands (main.rs ext_ipc_plugin, loopback.rs plugin_command_allowed); the loopback page gets the same at runtime for exactly that origin. No events, no http, no app commands beyond the invoke guard's.
